messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-02-24, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2026-02-24 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-24-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-29, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-09-29 to 2026-02-24; recorded by handover/2025-09-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-07-09, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-07-09 to 2025-09-29; recorded by handover/2025-07-09-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-07-09; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of 2025-09-08, billing-api has a new dependency on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- On 2026-03-31, the Ember team observed that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and flagged it because the service is not theirs. [valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
- On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder decided that clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds. [decision; valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28]
- On 2025-02-27, Team Boreal noticed the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-02-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-27]
- The feature-flags service saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of the requests were identical. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28]
- The scheduler pulls per-job kill switches from the feature-flags service on every run. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-28]
- Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- As of 2026-05-25, Team Atlas has switched to a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
- As of 2025-09-23, Team Cinder has switched to trunk-based development. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-23]
- Team Boreal adopted a weekly dependency update day. [decision; valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-27-2]
- As of 2026-02-10, the reports pipeline is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-10-reporting]
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to the Ember team, which took it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service belongs to Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas flagged that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the notifier is not their service. [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2]
- As of 2025-03-19, the Ember team does pairing on every production change. [decision; valid 2025-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19-2]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
